bugs.ISSUANCE_IGNORES_SCHEDULE: issuance (_create_pass_grant_core, 0060:404-408) ignores schedule windows while spin-time (_resolved_spin_wheel, 0060:135-138) ranks an open window above is_active
bugs.ACTIVE_ORDER_MISMATCH: with several is_active games issuance orders by created_at (0060:407) but spin-time orders by id (0060:139)

surprises.S1: pass.wheel_id is a label, not routing: an open schedule, the active flag or a pin serves a different game than the one the link was minted for
surprises.S2: a schedule window overrides the creator's active flag at play time, even for an unpinned link
surprises.S3: a game whose only schedule is in the future or already expired still serves as the oldest-game fallback when nothing else is live
surprises.S4: no DB guard stops a creator pinning another creator's wheel id; the resolver silently ignores such a pin and falls through
surprises.S5: a pinned game is served regardless of its own schedule window (future or expired)
surprises.S6: disabling the scratch feature leaves an existing scratch game pinned/scheduled/active and fans keep playing it (grandfathered)
surprises.S7: archiving the only live game turns the fan link into 'no_wheel' with credits intact
